title: Automated Vulnerability Testing of glibc _FORTIFY_SOURCE Functions
description: Reproducible test suite and reference dataset for automated fault-based vulnerability validation on _FORTIFY_SOURCE-hardened Ubuntu 26.04 binaries. The testfunc() oracle from the Witchcraft Compiler Collection (WCC) identifies 54 unique crashes across 52 functions, of which 33 carry an injected marker in the faulting address, proving attacker control of a pointer argument. All binaries are distribution-standard, compiled with -fPIE, _FORTIFY_SOURCE=2, and stack canaries. The experiment is fully deterministic (PRNG seed) and completes in ~4.3 hours on a single core.
